title: Ottawa commits $1.6B to Cohere for sovereign AI: what it means for Canadian data control
post:
Canadian banks are blocking AI agents. Is your business ready?

Major Canadian banks are taking a hard line on third-party AI agents accessing their platforms. This isn't just about big finance; it's a wake-up call for every Canadian business.

The AI landscape is shifting rapidly. We're moving beyond AI answering questions to AI acting on our behalf, negotiating and managing workflows. If your digital property isn't designed for machine interaction, you're effectively shutting the door on these new digital representatives.

The recent "Black October" attacks highlight a critical reality: AI infrastructure is a target. Businesses need to urgently review their AI security and vendor controls.

How are you preparing your business for the era of autonomous AI agents?
AI #CanadianBusiness #DataSecurity #SovereignAI
